title: 第八章  新的开始
content_zh:
哐！哐！
将李洛从黑暗中惊醒的，是那一阵阵的拍门声，他沉重的眼皮竭尽全力的缓缓睁开，印入眼帘的是那熟悉的房间布景。
“这是...怎么了？”
他喃喃自语，然后他就发现自己的声音虚弱到吓人，那气若游丝般的模样，犹如风中残烛的老人一般。
李洛挣扎着想要从地上爬起来，但尝试了半天，却是发现手脚一点力气都没有。
最终他只能躺在地上缓了半晌，这才有了力气踉跄的站起身来，然后一屁股坐在旁边的椅子上。
“少府主，你还好吗？”而此时，房间外传来了一道女子声音，听声音，似乎是姜青娥的那位助手，蔡薇。
李洛咳嗽了一声，回道：“起得晚了，怎么了？”
“是青娥让我来通知你，洛岚府九阁阁主都已到了，还请你准备一下。”蔡薇熟女那酥柔的声音传来。
“好的。”李洛看了一眼窗户缝隙外，此时天光已大亮，显然他是在地上躺了一夜。
听到李洛应下，门外的蔡薇虽然有些奇怪他声音的虚弱，但还是退走了。
李洛目光转向昨夜摆放水晶球的位置，却是惊愕的发现那黑色水晶球早已没了踪迹，只是有着一堆黑色的灰烬残留。
显然，黑色水晶球中的自毁装置启动，将一切都给抹除了。
李洛看向一侧的镜子，其中倒映着他的面庞，他只是看了一眼，便是面色忍不住的一变。
因为那镜子中的人，面色苍白得可怕，那种感觉，仿佛是体内的血液都被尽数的抽离了一般。
而且变化最大的，是他的头发...原本一头的黑发，此时直接是变成了灰白之色，显然是因为精血损失太多所导致。
李洛呆呆的望着镜子中一头白发的少年，好半晌后，方才吐了一口气：“竟然...变得更帅了。”
苦中作乐一番，李洛又是苦笑道：“果然，融合了那后天之相，自身储备了十七年的精血，都被消耗了大半...”
这种精血损失过度的情况，让得他感觉到了极度的虚弱，走几步都有种晕眩的感觉。
而且除此之外，他还感觉到身躯有着一种难以形容的莫名空虚感，那种空虚，并非是心境的空虚，而是...寿命的缺失。

李洛抿了抿没有血色的嘴唇，从现在开始，他就只剩下五年的寿命了吗？
真是让人...感到紧迫啊。
李洛吐了一口气，却是闭上眼目，然后开始感应体内。
他的感知，直接是沉入到了体内的相宫所在，在那以前，三座相宫皆是空空如也，可现在，在那第一座相宫内，却是绽放出了蔚蓝色的光彩，一股滋润柔和的力量，在不断的自那相宫中散发出来，同时侵润着枯竭的体内。
李洛的心神凝视着那座蔚蓝色的相宫，这一刻，饶是他已经有了心理准备，可依旧是忍不住的心潮澎湃。
果然，后天之相融合成功了。
从今天开始，他的空相问题，就彻底的解决了！
而且，这曾经给他带来诸多麻烦的空相，也将会显露出独属于它的特殊与神妙！
李洛睁开眼睛，他能够感觉到周围游离的天地能量，其中有两种能量在自动的对着他靠拢而来。
那是水与光明的能量。
以后，他就能够吸收这两种能量，继而将它们转化为属于他的真正相力。
不过前提是还得修炼能量引导术，但这都不是什么事，洛岚府好歹基业颇大，其中
李洛想着，便是缓缓的站起身来，然后进行了一番洗漱，还换了一身整洁的衣衫。
换好后，他对着镜子打量了一下，然后里面那虽然面容憔悴，头发灰白，但依旧难掩俊朗好看的五官的少年便是露出灿烂的笑容。
“李洛，新的生活欢迎你。”
南风城的这座的老宅，往日一直都是颇为的冷清，可今日气氛却罕见的有些凝重，老宅四周，布满着重重岗哨，护卫。
在老宅的大厅中，气氛更是沉凝，让人喘不过气来。
宽敞的大厅，座分两侧，而在正中有两座，一座空着，而另外一处则是端坐着姜青娥，她平静神色中带着许些冷冽。
她金色的眸子淡然的盯着大厅内，眸光偶尔会掠过左侧那排，那里有四道人影，皆是散发着强横的能量波动。
特别是左侧为首者。

那是一名看上去约莫二十七八的青年男子，他的模样其实算不得多出众，双目微微内陷，鼻翼有些狭长，右耳垂处，挂着一枚剑型的耳坠，隐隐有寒光流露。
他面庞上时刻都带着温和的笑容，倒是让人容易生出好感。
然而熟悉对方的姜青娥却明白，眼前的人，可不是什么善茬，她执掌洛岚府以来，正是此人对她造成了诸多的掣肘。
此人正是李太玄与澹台岚所收的记名弟子，如今洛岚府内的权势人物...裴昊。
而在其下侧的三道人影，则是被他所拉拢的三位阁主。
在他们这一排的对面，还坐着洛岚府另外的六位阁主，这六位阁主中，有四位是支持姜青娥的，还有两位则是保持着中立，并未偏向任何一方。
而光从这一点上面，就能够看出如今的洛岚府之中，究竟是何等的混乱...
失去了李太玄与澹台岚这两位顶梁柱，底蕴尚浅的洛岚府，的确是风雨飘摇。
沉凝的大厅中，安静持续了许久，唯有着众人品茶时发出的细微声音。
直到，左侧之首的裴昊，突然将茶杯不轻不重的放在了桌上，那清脆的声音在客厅中响起，顿时引得气氛一滞。
裴昊抬起头，目光投向姜青娥，微笑道：“小师妹，大家伙来这里等半天了，少府主怎么还不出来？”
“虽说他是少府主，但大家一直都是在为了洛岚府而打拼，要知道当初连师父师娘在的时候，这种场合都会准时出现的，这也表明了他们二老对我们这些人的看重啊。”
他的声音说出来，场中九位阁主有人神色不动，有人则是眉头微皱，也有人低声自语。
姜青娥神色冷淡的道：“以前师父师娘在时，怎么没见你这么没耐性？”
裴昊双目微眯，笑着看了姜青娥一眼，道：“小师妹，人，终归是要往前看的。”
他顿了顿，望着众人，道：“既然少府主迟迟未曾露面，我建议大家也就不必再等了，直接开始议事吧，毕竟...”
裴昊似是有些无奈的笑了笑，道：“少府主的情况，大家也都知道，今日所议之事，其实他不在场也更好一些，所以就让他清静一些吧。”
客厅内，众人神色各异，除了姜青娥，一时倒是无人说话。
“既然大家没异议，那就直接开始吧。”裴昊见状一笑，挥了挥手，直接就要决定下来。
姜青娥神色一冷，刚欲说话，一道笑声便是突然的自客厅的珠帘后响起。

“几年不见，裴昊师兄比起以前，当真是变得霸气了不少，我爹娘如果知道师兄如今这么有出息的话，想必也会欣慰的吧？”
随着笑声响起，客厅的珠帘也是被掀起，然后一名身躯修长，模样俊朗的少年，面带笑意的走了出来。
而当客厅内众人突然间见到那张面庞时，他们身体竟是不由自主的抖了一下，然后一时间条件反射般的站了起来。
因为那张面庞，与他们心中敬畏的那两人，格外的相似。
甚至于连那裴昊，面庞上挂着的笑意都是在此时微微的僵硬了一瞬，他身子似是不受控制的微曲了一下，不过就在他也要惯性般的站起的霎那，他心中陡然清明了许多。
因为眼前的人，可不是那两位了...
这只是一个空相的废人而已。
于是，他伸出手掌，突然拍在了旁边桌子上的茶杯上面，一声清脆声音响起，整个茶杯都被他拍成了粉末。
这声音响起，也是让得在场九位阁主惊了惊，然后他们也是猛然间回过神来。
接着，他们的面庞上都是浮现出一些尴尬之色，而那裴昊旁边的三位阁主，更是立刻坐了回去。
而另外一排的六位阁主，则是犹豫了一下后，对着走出来的李洛抱拳行礼。
“见过少府主。”
他们此时再定神看着李洛，方才发现虽然他与李太玄，澹台岚有些相似，但终归没有那种令人敬畏的气势，显得要稚嫩青涩太多。
先前那种错觉只是一晃眼间，有点没能回过神而已。
而且最让得他们感到诧异的是，李洛那一头灰白发丝。
甚至连姜青娥，都是眸光中带着一些惊疑的在李洛头上停了停，这家伙明明昨天都还好好的...
李洛对着这六位阁主点头示意，然后目光转向了那坐在椅子上动也不动的裴昊，笑道：“几年不见裴昊师兄，当真是与以往判若两人啊。”
在场的九位阁主目光闪了闪，倒是听出了李洛话语间的蕴含之意。
在以前那些年，李太玄与澹台岚尚在的时候，每一次裴昊见到李洛时，可都是笑容温和得犹如大哥哥一般，甚至还会费尽心思的给他带上诸多的礼物。
只是，恐怕那时候，就连李太玄与澹台岚都未曾想到，这个对他们毕恭毕敬的弟子，当他们在失踪多年后，便是会显露出这般本性来吧。

裴昊面带许些的笑意，他抬头注视着李洛，道：“许久不见，小洛真是长大了许多啊。”
他言语忽然的顿了顿，皱眉认真的道：“只是为何脸色如此的惨白，头发也白了，看上去...倒是跟没几年要活了一样？”
content_en:
Bang! Bang!
What woke Li Luo out of the darkness was the sound of knocks on the door. His heavy eyelids slowly opened with all his strength, and what came into view was the familiar room setting.
"What's going on?"
He murmured to himself, and then he realized that his voice was frighteningly weak, and his breath was like a gossamer, like an old man with a candle in the wind.
Li Luo struggled to get up from the ground, but after trying for a long time, he found that his hands and feet had no strength at all.
In the end, he could only lie on the ground and rest for a long time, then he had the strength to stand up staggeringly, and then sat down on the chair next to him.
"Young Master, are you okay?" At this time, a female voice came from outside the room. From the sound of the voice, it seemed to be Jiang Qing'e's assistant, Cai Wei.
Li Luo coughed and replied: "I got up late, what's wrong?"
"Qing'e asked me to inform you that the masters of the nine pavilions of Luo Lan Mansion have arrived. Please prepare." Came the soft voice of Cai Wei, a mature woman.
"Okay." Li Luo glanced outside the window. It was already bright. It was obvious that he had been lying on the ground all night.
Hearing Li Luo's response, Cai Wei outside the door was a little surprised by the weakness of his voice, but she still retreated.
Li Luo turned his eyes to the place where the crystal ball was placed last night, but was shocked to find that the black crystal ball was no longer there, only a pile of black ashes remained.
Apparently, the self-destruction device in the black crystal ball was activated, erasing everything.
Li Luo looked at the mirror on one side, which reflected his face. He just glanced at it, and his expression couldn't help but change.
Because the person in the mirror looked horribly pale, and it felt as if all the blood in his body had been drained out.
And the biggest change was his hair... His original black hair turned gray, obviously due to too much blood loss.
Li Luo stared blankly at the white-haired boy in the mirror. After a long while, he breathed out: "He actually...has become more handsome."
After enjoying the pain, Li Luo smiled bitterly and said: "Sure enough, after integrating the acquired appearance, most of the blood essence and blood he had stored for seventeen years was consumed..."
This excessive loss of essence and blood made him feel extremely weak, and he felt dizzy even after taking a few steps.
And besides that, he also felt an indescribable sense of emptiness in his body. That emptiness was not the emptiness of his state of mind, but...the lack of lifespan.
Li Luo pursed his bloodless lips. From now on, will he only have five years left to live?
It's really... urgent.
Li Luo breathed out, closed his eyes, and then began to sense the body.
His perception directly sank into the location of the phase palace in his body. Before that, the three phase palaces were all empty, but now, in the first phase palace, there was a blue brilliance blooming, and a nourishing and soft power was constantly emanating from the phase palace, and at the same time infiltrating the exhausted body.
Li Luo's mind was staring at the azure palace. At this moment, even though he was mentally prepared, he still couldn't help but feel his heart surge.
Sure enough, the fusion of acquired nature was successful.
Starting from today, his empty phase problem will be completely solved!
Moreover, this empty phase that once brought him a lot of trouble will also reveal its own specialness and wonder!
Li Luo opened his eyes, and he could feel the free energy of heaven and earth around him, two of which were automatically approaching him.
That is the energy of water and light.
From now on, he will be able to absorb these two energies and then transform them into his true phase power.
However, the premise is that you have to practice energy guidance, but this is not a big deal. After all, Luo Lan Mansion has a large foundation, among whichLi Luo thought and slowly stood up, then washed himself and changed into neat clothes.
After changing, he looked in the mirror, and then the young man inside, although he had a haggard face and gray hair, still had handsome and good-looking features, showed a bright smile.
"Li Luo, welcome to your new life."
This old house in Nanfeng City has always been quite deserted in the past, but today the atmosphere is rare and dignified. The old house is surrounded by numerous sentries and guards.
In the hall of the old house, the atmosphere was even more solemn and breathless.
The spacious hall has seats on both sides, and there are two seats in the middle. One is empty, and in the other sits Jiang Qing'e, with a hint of coldness in her calm expression.
Her golden eyes stared calmly into the hall, occasionally passing by the row on the left, where there were four figures, all exuding tyrannical energy fluctuations.
Especially those on the left.
It was a young man who looked about twenty-seven or eighty-year-old. His appearance was actually not that outstanding. His eyes were slightly sunken, his nose was a bit narrow, and there was a sword-shaped earring hanging from his right earlobe, which had a faint cold light.
He always has a gentle smile on his face, which makes it easy for people to like him.
However, Jiang Qing'e, who was familiar with the other party, understood that the person in front of her was not a good person. It was this person who had caused many constraints to her since she took charge of Luo Lan Mansion.
This person is the named disciple accepted by Li Taixuan and Tantai Lan, and now a powerful figure in Luo Lan Mansion... Pei Hao.
The three figures on the lower side are the three pavilion masters whom he has attracted.
Opposite their row, there are six other pavilion masters from Luo Lan Mansion. Among these six pavilion masters, four support Jiang Qing'e, and the other two remain neutral and do not favor any party.
And just from this point, we can see how chaotic the Luo Lan Mansion is now...
After losing the two pillars of Li Taixuan and Tantai Lan, the Luo Lan Mansion, which still had little foundation, was indeed in a state of turmoil.
In the quiet hall, the silence lasted for a long time, with only the faint sounds of people sipping tea.
Until, Pei Hao, the leader on the left, suddenly placed the teacup on the table, not lightly nor heavily. The crisp sound sounded in the living room, causing the atmosphere to freeze.
Pei Hao raised his head, looked at Jiang Qing'e, and said with a smile: "Little junior sister, you guys have been waiting here for a long time, why doesn't the young master come out?"
"Although he is the Young Mansion Master, everyone has always been working hard for the Luo Lan Mansion. You must know that when Master and Master were here, such occasions would appear on time. This also shows how much the two elders value us."
When his voice came out, some of the nine pavilion masters in the room looked unmoved, some frowned slightly, and some whispered to themselves.
Jiang Qing'e said with a cold expression: "When Master and Master were here before, why didn't I see you so impatient?"
Pei Hao narrowed his eyes slightly, glanced at Jiang Qing'e with a smile, and said, "Junior sister, you have to look forward after all."
He paused, looked at everyone, and said: "Since the young palace master has not shown up yet, I suggest that you don't have to wait any longer and start discussing things directly. After all..."
Pei Hao smiled helplessly and said: "Everyone knows about the situation of the young master of the palace. It is actually better if he is not present for what is being discussed today, so let him be quiet."
In the living room, everyone had different expressions. Except for Jiang Qing'e, no one spoke for a while.
"Since everyone has no objections, let's get started." Pei Hao smiled upon seeing this, waved his hand, and was about to make a decision.
Jiang Qing'e's expression turned cold, and just as she was about to speak, a burst of laughter suddenly sounded from behind the bead curtain in the living room.
"We haven't seen each other for a few years. Senior brother Pei Hao has become much more domineering than before. If my parentsIf you know that your senior brother is so promising now, you will surely be happy, right? "
As laughter rang out, the bead curtain in the living room was lifted, and then a slender and handsome young man walked out with a smile on his face.
And when everyone in the living room suddenly saw that face, their bodies trembled involuntarily, and then they stood up reflexively.
Because that face was extremely similar to the two people they were in awe of.
Even the smile on Pei Hao's face froze slightly at this moment. His body seemed to bend slightly uncontrollably, but at the moment when he was about to stand up inertly, his heart suddenly became much clearer.
Because the people in front of me are not those two...
This is just an empty useless person.
So, he stretched out his palm and suddenly slapped it on the teacup on the table next to him. There was a crisp sound and the entire teacup was turned into powder by him.
This sound made the nine pavilion masters present startled, and then they suddenly came back to their senses.
Then, some embarrassment appeared on their faces, and the three pavilion masters next to Pei Hao immediately sat back.
The six pavilion masters in the other row hesitated for a moment and then saluted with clasped fists at Li Luo who came out.
“I’ve met the Young Palace Master. "
At this time, they looked at Li Luo intently, and realized that although he was somewhat similar to Li Taixuan and Tantai Lan, he did not have the awe-inspiring aura after all, and he seemed too immature and green.
The previous illusion was just for a blink of an eye, and I couldn't recover from it.
And what surprised them the most was Li Luo's gray hair.
Even Jiang Qing'e paused at Li Luo's head with some surprise in her eyes. This guy was obviously fine yesterday...
Li Luo nodded to the six pavilion masters, then turned his eyes to Pei Hao, who was sitting motionless on the chair, and said with a smile: "Senior Brother Pei Hao is really a different person after not seeing him for several years. "
The eyes of the nine pavilion masters present flashed, and they actually heard the implications of Li Luo's words.
In the past years, when Li Taixuan and Tantai Lan were still together, every time Pei Hao saw Li Luo, he would smile as warmly as an older brother, and would even go to great lengths to bring him many gifts.
However, I am afraid that at that time, even Li Taixuan and Tantai Lan had never thought that this disciple who was respectful to them would show such a true nature after they disappeared for many years.
With a slight smile on his face, Pei Hao looked up at Li Luo and said, "Long time no see, Xiao Luo has really grown up a lot. "
He suddenly paused in his words, frowned and said seriously: "But why is his face so pale, his hair also white, and it looks... as if he has only a few years to live? "
